story.fullStory:
The Moody Blues's "Nights In White Satin" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Nights in White Satin" is a song by English rock band the Moody Blues, written by Justin Hayward.

It was first featured as the segment "The Night" on the album Days of Future Passed.

When first released as a single in 1967, it reached number 19 on the UK Singles Chart and number 103 in the United States in 1968.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.
